info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Osprey Battery Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Osprey Battery Detail Management API allows users to create and manage detailed records of Osprey battery specifications. This endpoint facilitates the input of crucial data, ensuring accurate documentation and organization of battery attributes. Ideal for product managers and inventory specialists, this API supports the efficient tracking and cataloging of battery information. By leveraging this API, organizations can enhance their operational efficiency in battery management and optimize their product offerings.

post.description: This API endpoint allows developers to create and submit details related to the Osprey battery. It handles all necessary validations and processes the information for storage in the system.

requestBody.description: Request body for posting details about the Osprey battery. This should contain all necessary information pertaining to the battery's specifications and performance data.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning battery details.

CreateCatalogOspreyBatteryDetailRequest.title: Osprey Battery Operation Request

osprey_battery_id.description: The unique identifier for the Osprey battery.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person or entity making the request.

quantity.description: The number of Osprey batteries requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates whether the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Osprey battery.

supplier.description: Details about the supplier providing the Osprey batteries.

CreateCatalogOspreyBatteryDetailRequest.description: Schema for the request body to perform operations related to Osprey battery details.

SupplierDetails.title: Supplier Details

verified.description: Indicates whether the supplier has been verified.

SupplierDetails.description: Schema for details about the supplier of the Osprey batteries.

ContactInformation.title: Contact Information

email.description: The email address of the supplier.

phone.description: The phone number of the supplier.

ContactInformation.description: Schema for the contact information of the supplier.

CreateCatalogOspreyBatteryDetailResponse.title: Osprey Battery Details Response

status.description: The status of the operation indicating whether it was successful or not.

recordId.description: The unique identifier for the record created or updated through the operation.

processedAt.description: The timestamp indicating when the operation was processed.

matchedCount.description: The number of records matched during the operation.

CreateCatalogOspreyBatteryDetailResponse.description: Response schema for the details operation of the Osprey battery when a POST request is successfully processed.

content-type.description: Specifies the media type of the resource being returned in the response. Common values include 'application/json' for JSON data.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, that the server took to process the request. This helps in assessing the performance of the API.
